items.source: Remove elements in Range from sorted set with ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 从有序集中移除元素，该元素属于Range，并使用ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()获取键。

items.source: Get one-by-one the time to live for keys.
items.translation: 逐个获取键的生存时间。

items.source: Removes the ReactiveListCommands.LRemCommand.getCount() occurrences of ReactiveListCommands.LRemCommand.getValue() from the list stored at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 从存储在 ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey() 的列表中，移除 ReactiveListCommands.LRemCommand.getCount() 个值为 ReactiveListCommands.LRemCommand.getValue() 的元素。

items.source: Append a ReactiveStringCommands.AppendCommand.getValue() to the ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 向ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()追加一个ReactiveStringCommands.AppendCommand.getValue()。

items.source: Expire a List of field after a given Duration of time, measured in milliseconds, has passed.
items.translation: 在指定的时间间隔（以毫秒为单位）经过后，从字段后的 List 中移除过期项。

items.source: Store the members within given GeoShape from GeoReference applying given parameters in a new geo set.
items.translation: 将给定GeoShape内的成员，根据给定的参数从GeoReference中存储到新的地理集合中。

items.source: Add given ReactiveSetCommands.SAddCommand.getValues() to set at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 将给定的ReactiveSetCommands.SAddCommand.getValues()添加到在ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()处的集合中。

items.source: Remove given ReactiveSetCommands.SRemCommand.getValues() from set at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 从ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()处的集合中移除给定的ReactiveSetCommands.SRemCommand.getValues()。

items.source: Add ReactiveZSetCommands.ZAddCommand.getTuples() to a sorted set at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey(), or update its score if it already exists.
items.translation: 向有序集合添加 ReactiveZSetCommands.ZAddCommand.getTuples()，位置为 ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()；如果该元素已存在，则更新其分数。

items.source: Increment the score of element with ReactiveZSetCommands.ZIncrByCommand.getValue() in sorted set by ReactiveZSetCommands.ZIncrByCommand.getIncrement().
items.translation: 将有序集中具有 ReactiveZSetCommands.ZIncrByCommand.getValue() 的元素的分数增加 ReactiveZSetCommands.ZIncrByCommand.getIncrement()。

items.source: Get the score of element with ReactiveZSetCommands.ZScoreCommand.getValue() from sorted set with key ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()
items.translation: 获取具有键的有序集中元素的分数，该元素由 ReactiveZSetCommands.ZScoreCommand.getValue() 指定。

items.source: Add RedisGeoCommands.GeoLocations to key.
items.translation: 向键中添加RedisGeoCommands.GeoLocation。

items.source: Persist a given List of field removing any associated expiration.
items.translation: 保持给定的 List，移除任何相关的过期信息。

items.source: Returns the time-to-live of all the given field in the List in milliseconds.
items.translation: 返回指定字段在List中的所有元素的生存时间（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source: Returns the time-to-live of all the given field in the List in seconds.
items.translation: 返回指定字段在List中的所有字段的生存时间（以秒为单位）。

items.source: Get the size of list stored at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()
items.translation: 获取存储在ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()处的列表大小。

items.source: Get indices of the element from list at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 获取来自ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()的元素的索引。

items.source: Get size of set at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 获取集合的大小，参见ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()。

items.source: Overwrite parts of ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.key starting at the specified offset with given ReactiveStringCommands.SetRangeCommand.value.
items.translation: 覆盖 `ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.key` 中从指定偏移量开始的部分，使用给定的 `ReactiveStringCommands.SetRangeCommand.value`。

items.source: Returns the cardinality of the set which would result from the intersection of all given sets at ReactiveSetCommands.SInterCardCommand.getKeys().
items.translation: 返回由给定所有集合的交集所产生的集合的基数，该集合位于 ReactiveSetCommands.SInterCardCommand.getKeys()。

items.source: Get the size of the stream stored at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()
items.translation: 获取存储在ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()处的流的大小。

items.source: Get the size of sorted set with keyCommand#getKey().
items.translation: 使用keyCommand#getKey()获取有序集合的大小。

items.source: Count number of elements within sorted set with scores within Range.
items.translation: 计算排序集中分数在Range范围内的元素数量。

items.source: Count number of elements within sorted set with value between Range#min and Range#max applying lexicographical ordering.
items.translation: 计算有序集合中值介于Range#min和Range#max之间的元素数量，采用字典序排序。

items.source: Determine the index of element with value in a sorted set when scored by ReactiveZSetCommands.ZRankCommand.getDirection().
items.translation: 确定在通过 ReactiveZSetCommands.ZRankCommand.getDirection() 进行评分的有序集合中，具有该值的元素的索引。

items.source: Remove ReactiveZSetCommands.ZRemCommand.getValues() from sorted set.
items.translation: 从有序集合中移除 ReactiveZSetCommands.ZRemCommand.getValues()。

items.source: Emit the position of the first bit set to given bit in a string.
items.translation: 给定字符串中的 `bit`，发出第一个被置位的位的位置。

items.source: Get the length of the value associated with field.
items.translation: 获取与 `field` 关联的值长度。

items.source: Unlink the keys from the keyspace.
items.translation: 将 `keys` 从键空间中解绑。

items.source: Alter the last access time of given key(s).
items.translation: 修改给定key(s)的最后访问时间。

items.source: Unlink the key from the keyspace.
items.translation: 将 `key` 从键空间中解绑。

items.source: Trims the stream to count elements.
items.translation: 将流修剪为 ``count` 个元素。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source:
Count the number of set bits (population counting) of value stored at key between start and
end.
items.translation: 统计键在 start 和 end 之间存储值的置位数量（人口计数）。

items.source: Perform bitwise operations between strings.
items.translation: 对字符串执行位运算。

items.source: Decrement value of key by 1.
items.translation: 将键的值减 1。

items.source: Decrement value of key by value.
items.translation: 将键的值减去指定值。

items.source: Delete keys one by one.
items.translation: 逐个删除键。

items.source: Delete given hash fields.
items.translation: 删除给定的哈希字段。

items.source: Increment value of a hash field by the given value.
items.translation: 将哈希字段的值增加指定数值。

items.source: Get size of hash at key.
items.translation: 获取键处哈希的大小。

items.source: Increment value of key by 1.
items.translation: 将键的自增数值加 1。

items.source: Increment value of key by value.
items.translation: 将键的值增加指定值。

items.source: Delete multiple keys in batches.
items.translation: 批量删除多个键。

items.source: Adds given values to the HyperLogLog stored at given key.
items.translation: 将给定值添加到指定键所存储的 HyperLogLog 中。

items.source: Return the approximated cardinality of the structures observed by the HyperLogLog at key(s).
items.translation: 返回 HyperLogLog 在指定键处观测到的结构的近似基数。

items.source: Diff all given sets at keys and store result in destinationKey.
items.translation: 在指定键处对所有给定集合执行差异操作，并将结果存储到目标键中。

items.source: Intersect all given sets at keys and store result in destinationKey.
items.translation: 在给定集合的所有键处求交集，并将结果存储在 destinationKey 中。

items.source: Get the length of the value stored at key.
items.translation: 获取存储在键处的值的长度。

items.source: Union all given sets at keys and store result in destinationKey.
items.translation: 将所有集合按键合并，并将结果存储到 destinationKey 中。

items.source: Acknowledge one or more records as processed.
items.translation: 确认一个或多个记录已处理。

items.source: Diff sorted sets and store result in destination destinationKey.
items.translation: 对已排序集合进行差集运算，并将结果存储到目标键 destinationKey 中。

items.source:
Intersect sorted sets by applying aggregateFunction and store result in destination
destinationKey and apply weights to individual sets.
items.translation: 通过应用 aggregateFunction 对有序集合进行交集运算，并将结果存储到目标键 destinationKey 中，同时为各个集合应用权重。

items.source:
Union sorted sets by applying aggregateFunction and store result in destination
destinationKey and apply weights to individual sets.
items.translation: 使用 aggregateFunction 对联合排序集合进行聚合，并将结果存储到目标 destinationKey 中，同时为各个集合应用权重。

items.source: Uses of ReactiveRedisConnection.NumericResponse in org.springframework.data.redis.connection
items.translation: ReactiveRedisConnection.NumericResponse 在 org.springframework.data.redis.connection 中的用途
